de: Dear Alexander Andreevich, Ilya Sergeevich, Damian Dmitrievich and Timofey Vitalyevich! I congratulate you, your mentors and fans on a brilliant performance in Nanjing. I will note team unity, individual skill and winning…

de: Dear Alexandra Vladimirovna, Elena Alexandrovna, Arina Stepanovna and Polina Vasilievna! Congratulations on the gold of the World Cup-2026. You showed a fighting character, demonstrated impeccable technique and real life…
